text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text: In a certain labyrinth, {0} was fighting monsters that attacked him.
text_block_list.orig_text:
とある迷宮にて、
{0}は
襲い来る魔物たちと戦っていた。

text_block_list.name: Monster
text_block_list.text: ...GUOOOH!
text_block_list.orig_text: ──グオオオオオッ！

text_block_list.text: Ahhh, Boy. You're in a good position, but if you could step back a bit it would be better. If you stay there you'll be caught up together with the enemy.
text_block_list.orig_text:
あー、
少年。
いい位置にいるけど
もうちょい下がってくれると助かるな。
そこだと
敵と一緒に巻き込まれちゃうよ～？

text_block_list.name: Labyrista
text_block_list.text: All right, what a good boy. Target in sight. Three medium-sized monsters. Distance is 600 meters, the aim is good...
text_block_list.orig_text:
よーし、
いい子だ。
標的目視。
中型の魔物が３体か。
距離600、
照準よし……

text_block_list.name: Labyrista
text_block_list.text: They've crossed the line of fire... alright, time to start the show!
text_block_list.orig_text:
射線は通った──
じゃ、
いっちょ始めますか！

text_block_list.name: Labyrista
text_block_list.text: First up, customer no.1!
text_block_list.orig_text:
まずは
最初のお客さんからっ！

text_block_list.name: Monster
text_block_list.text: ⁇ Gyaaaaah!?
text_block_list.orig_text: ──ギャオオオオオッ！？

text_block_list.name: Labyrista
text_block_list.text: Two more! I won't let you get away! Toh!
text_block_list.orig_text:
あと二体！
逃がさないよ──
っと！

text_block_list.name: Monster
text_block_list.text: Guooooooo!!
text_block_list.orig_text: ──グオオオオオッ！！

text_block_list.name: Labyrista
text_block_list.text: Huh?! You're tough... Then one shot in the head and the heart both... will do!
text_block_list.orig_text:
あれ！？　
タフだなぁ……
なら、
頭と心臓に一発ずつ……
確実に！

text_block_list.name: Labyrista
text_block_list.text: ...Signs of any enemy following us... none. Boy, are those all the ones that were in the den?
text_block_list.orig_text:
……後続の敵影なし。
少年、
巣穴にいたのはあれで全部？

text_block_list.name: Labyrista
text_block_list.text: All within your visual range, you say. Understood, then let's move on.
text_block_list.orig_text:
視認できる範囲だと全部だった、
と。
了解、
それじゃ進もうか。

text_block_list.name: Labyrista
text_block_list.text: This weapon is not really suited for close-quarters combat. I'm really glad you came with me, Boy.
text_block_list.orig_text:
この武器だと
流石に接近戦は不向きでさ。
ほんっと、
少年が来てくれて助かったよ。

text_block_list.name: Labyrista
text_block_list.text: After all, right now──I can't use my powers anymore.
text_block_list.orig_text:
なにせ今は──
権能が使えなくなっちゃってるから。

text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text: That day, {0} had received a top-secret message from Labyrista.
text_block_list.orig_text:
その日、
{0}は
ラビリスタから極秘の相談を受けていた。

text_block_list.name: Labyrista
text_block_list.text: That's right. Things have gotten JUUUST a little tricky... I could only turn towards someone who I can move freely with and who I can trust with my back. And with those specifications, you're the only one I can rely on right now.
text_block_list.orig_text:
そうなんだ。
ちょっとまずい事態になっててね……
自由に動けて、
かつ本当に信頼できる相手でないと頼めない。
今頼れるのが
キミしかいないんだ。

text_block_list.name: Labyrista
text_block_list.text: Let's go over the ongoing situation again. You know that recently, Astrum was almost overwritten by a previous version that was in development, right?
text_block_list.orig_text:
状況を改めて確認しておこう。
この前、
アストルムが
開発中だった過去のバージョンに
上書きされかけた
っていうのは、
キミも知ってるよね？

text_block_list.name: Labyrista
text_block_list.text: At the time this... Alpha Avatar was restored as a result. I wonder if there was an error during restoration? It's clearly a glitch.
text_block_list.orig_text:
その時に復元された、
この──
始原の冠装なんだけど。
復元時のエラーかな？
不具合が起きちゃっててね。

text_block_list.name: Labyrista
text_block_list.text: Right now, I'm trying to keep things consistent, using immediate fixes to pin down any bugs I can find, however... I can't keep up with those measures anymore.
text_block_list.orig_text:
今は
なんとか整合性を取って、
応急処置でバグをねじ伏せてはいるけど……
段々、
修正が追い付かなくなってきてるんだ。

text_block_list.name: Labyrista
text_block_list.text: About that, it seems like I'm currently stuck in this form. You could see it as a cursed piece of equipment, so to speak. What's more, it comes with a debuff that weakens it over time due to accumulated errors.
text_block_list.orig_text:
それが、
どうにもこの姿で固定されちゃってるみたいで。
いわば
呪いの装備化しちゃってるわけ。
おまけに時間が経つとエラー蓄積で弱体化するデバフ付き。

text_block_list.name: Labyrista
text_block_list.text: Since things will only get worse if I were to leave those bugs alone, I can't afford to take my time and need to make adjustments on it.
text_block_list.orig_text:
放っておけば悪化する以上、
ゆっくり調整なんて悠長な事も言ってられない状況だ。

text_block_list.name: Labyrista
text_block_list.text: And that's where you come in--I have to get my powers back as quickly as possible. To do that, I need a reliable partner.
text_block_list.orig_text:
だからアタシは──
最速で力を取り戻さなくちゃいけない。
そのために
信頼できる相棒を求めてる。

text_block_list.name: Labyrista
text_block_list.text: Now is finally time for me to drop this line. Will you lend me your strength? My Princess Knight.
text_block_list.orig_text:
今こそ、
こう言わせてもらう時だろうね。
どうか力を貸してくれないかな？
アタシのプリンセスナイト。

text_block_list.name: Labyrista
text_block_list.text: Okay. I'm sure glad you're quick on the uptake. I'll be right behind you.
text_block_list.orig_text:
オーケー、
話が早くて助かるよ。
すぐにでも出発しよう。

text_block_list.name: Labyrista
text_block_list.text: Boy, over here, come.
text_block_list.orig_text:
少年、
こっちこっち。

text_block_list.name: Labyrista
text_block_list.text: ...Oh, there it is. Just click here and...
text_block_list.orig_text:
……お、あった。
ここを
ポチっとなっと。

text_block_list.name: Labyrista
text_block_list.text: Of course. It's a secret passage. There'd be no point if just anyone could find it, right?
text_block_list.orig_text:
そ、
隠し通路ってやつ。
人に知られちゃ意味ないでしょ？

text_block_list.name: Labyrista
text_block_list.text: It's a good idea to have access to it just in case. It could create a future vulnerability, but it's helpful in times like this.
text_block_list.orig_text:
万が一に備えたアクセス手段は用意しといて正解だね。
脆弱性にもなり得るけど、
こういう時は助かる。

text_block_list.name: Labyrista
text_block_list.text: That being said, mountain climbing is tough on the legs and hips! It would be a lot easier if I could use my powers authority.
text_block_list.orig_text:
とはいえ、
山登りは
足腰に
堪えるね～！
権能が使えればもっと楽できたんだけどなぁ。

text_block_list.name: Labyrista
text_block_list.text: Huh? Didn't you notice? We've been walking all the way over here.
text_block_list.orig_text:
あれ、
気づかなかった？
ここまでの道中、
ずっと徒歩で来たでしょ。

text_block_list.name: Labyrista
text_block_list.text: You see, maybe because my Alpha Avatar form has become unstable, there have also been problems related to the usage of my authority.
text_block_list.orig_text:
実は、
始原の冠装が不安定になってるせいか
権能の行使にも不具合が出てるんだよね。

text_block_list.name: Labyrista
text_block_list.text: I mean, well, if it's just a matter of being able to use it, I can use it... but it'd be a dangerous gamble until I can use it properly again.
text_block_list.orig_text:
いやまあ、
使うだけなら使えるかもだけど……
安定して使えるようになるまでは危ないからね。

text_block_list.name: Labyrista
text_block_list.text: You see, if you try to take a convenient shortcut and the coordinates of the destination you specified are wrong, you might end up buried alive in dirt or rocks!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ほ
ら、
便利にショートカットしようとして
指定した行き先の座標がおかしくなってたりするとさ、
土とか
岩の中に生き埋め！　
なんてなるかもだし。

text_block_list.name: Labyrista
text_block_list.text: It would be one thing if you were in a place where you could physically escape, but you don't want to get stuck in the wrong space and be unable to get out for the rest of your life, right?
text_block_list.orig_text:
物理的に脱出できる場所ならまだしも、
下手な空間にハマって、
一生出て来られない
とか御免でしょ？

text_block_list.name: Labyrista
text_block_list.text: You could end up dead inside the stone, or you could wander forever in an unknown space... At the very least, I wouldn't recommend taking that gamble until we're sure it's safe.
text_block_list.orig_text:
石の中にいてお陀仏か、
永久にどこか分からない空間を彷徨うか……
少なくとも
安全が確認できるまでは
ちょっとオススメできないかな～

text_block_list.name: Labyrista
text_block_list.text: And that's why... we have no choice but to keep moving forward. There's still a long way to go, so you'd better be prepared for the trek, Boy.
text_block_list.orig_text:
だから、
アタシたちは地道に進むしかないってわけ。
まだまだこの先長いから、
少年も覚悟しておいて。

text_block_list.name: Labyrista
text_block_list.text: This is the path that leads to our hideout. It's a maze built so that people who accidentally wandered into it or people that harbor malice in their intentions won't be able to reach its core even if they try.
text_block_list.orig_text:
これが
アタシたちのアジトに続く道。
偶然迷い込んだ人とか
悪意を持った連中とかが
まかり間違っても辿りつけないよう迷路になってる。

text_block_list.name: Labyrista
text_block_list.text: That being said, this is also the road back to my house that I know well. Please leave your worries behind and follow me.
text_block_list.orig_text:
とはいっても、
勝手知ったる我が家への道だ。
安心してついてきて。

text_block_list.name: Labyrista
text_block_list.text: To be honest, if Rino-chan and Shizuru-chan were here, we'd be perfectly geared up to deal with this situation, but... I asked them to run some other errands, and they can't come back right away.
text_block_list.orig_text:
本当はリノちゃんとシズルちゃんも居てくれると、
万全の態勢だったんだけど……
他に用事を頼んじゃってて、
すぐには戻ってこれないし。

text_block_list.name: Labyrista
text_block_list.text: Oh, there it is. First, turn right at that corner--
text_block_list.orig_text:
っと、そこだ。
まずはそこの角を右に曲がって──

text_block_list.name: Labyrista
text_block_list.text: ...Huh? Did we... pass through here before already...?
text_block_list.orig_text:
……あれ、
ここってさっきも通ったっけ？

text_block_list.name: Labyrista
text_block_list.text: N-N-No, that can't be right! To hear that "Queen Labyrinth" got lost in a maze would be too much of a joke!
text_block_list.orig_text:
いやー、
そんなはずはない！
迷宮女王が迷子だなんてシャレにもなんないよ！

text_block_list.name: Labyrista
text_block_list.text: Wait a moment, let's go back the way we came. I have the route we've taken so far mapped out in my mind, so if we go in the reverse order, we should be able to get back to where we were...
text_block_list.orig_text:
ちょっと待って、
来た道を戻ろう。
今まで辿ってきたルートは脳内マッピングしてあるから、
その逆順に進めば元に戻るはず……

text_block_list.name: Labyrista
text_block_list.text: ...This is strange. Absolutely strange.
text_block_list.orig_text:
……おかしい。
絶対におかしい。

text_block_list.name: Labyrista
text_block_list.text: That's not true! I just can't believe that I, of all people, would get lost...huh?
text_block_list.orig_text:
そんな事ないもん！
まさか
このアタシに限って、
道を間違えるなんて……
んん？

text_block_list.name: Labyrista
text_block_list.text: Wait a sec, this rock wall and object placement... The corridors arranged like a checkerboard... I feel like I've seen them before. So maybe this place is also...
text_block_list.orig_text:
待てよ、
この岩壁とオブジェクト配置……
碁盤の目のように整列された通路……
見覚えがあるぞ。
そうなると、
もしかしてここも……

text_block_list.name: Labyrista
text_block_list.text: ...I knew it, that's what's going on! Gear up, Boy!
text_block_list.orig_text:
……やっぱりそうだ！　
分かったぞ少年！

text_block_list.name: Labyrista
text_block_list.text: I wasn't wrong at all, the one at fault--is this very world!
text_block_list.orig_text:
アタシが間違ってたんじゃない──
間違ってるのは、
この世界の方だ！

text_block_list.name: Labyrista
text_block_list.text: Ah, wait a minute! Sorry, I'll explain it step by step, so don't look at me like "This woman's finally lost it..."! Please stop!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ああ、ちょっと待った！
ごめん、順を追って説明するから
「こいつ、
とうとうおかしく……」
みたいな目で見ないで！

text_block_list.name: Labyrista
text_block_list.text: I should've assumed this would happen the moment the restored data started malfunctioning... No wonder it looks familiar.
text_block_list.orig_text:
復元したデータに不具合が出てる時点で
こうなってることも想定しておくべきだったなぁ……
どうりで見覚えがあるはずだよ。

text_block_list.name: Labyrista
text_block_list.text: This is a section of ​​Astrum that was still under development... in more specific words, a special dungeon that was scrapped and never implemented.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ここは
アストルムの開発途中だった区画……
実装中止になった
特殊ダンジョンだ。

text_block_list.name: Labyrista
text_block_list.text: It seems that in the process of restoring what was about to be rolled back to a previous version, development data that was supposed to have been discarded was also pulled out in turn. And here we have it: the path to our hideout is now a dungeon.
text_block_list.orig_text:
過去にロールバックされかかったのを復元する途中で、
破棄されたはずの開発データまで引っ張り出されたみたいだね。
アジトへの道がダンジョン化してしまったらしい。

text_block_list.name: Labyrista
text_block_list.text: True enough, in terms of systems this dungeon was feature complete... but the flow of time here is special, so it's a little different from the outside.
text_block_list.orig_text:
確かに、
システム的にはほぼ完成してたけど……
ここは時間の流れが特殊でね、
外とは
ちょっと違うんだ。

text_block_list.name: Labyrista
text_block_list.text: To be more specific--Time will not progress unless the player takes a certain number of steps. Or more accurately, "No events will occur".
text_block_list.orig_text:
具体的に言うと──
プレイヤーが一定歩数進まない限り
時間は進まない。
より正しく言えば
『イベントが発生しない』。

text_block_list.name: Labyrista
text_block_list.text: I wonder if you've played a game like this before with Rin-chan or Yori-chan? Something like "Glenn the Wanderer" or "Yoruneko's Great Adventure"?
text_block_list.orig_text:
ヨリちゃんとかリンちゃんが遊んでないかな？
『風来坊のグレン』とか
『ヨルネコの大冒険』とかさ。

text_block_list.name: Labyrista
text_block_list.text: But the fact that this dungeon has appeared means that there must have been some changes made to its underlying system as well──
text_block_list.orig_text:
でも
このダンジョンが顕現したってことは、
システムにも恐らく改変が加わっているはずで──

text_block_list.name: Monster
text_block_list.text: Guooooooo!!
text_block_list.orig_text: ──グオオオオオッ！！

text_block_list.name: Labyrista
text_block_list.text: Wait just a minute, Boy! Don't move so careles--
text_block_list.orig_text:
ちょっと待った少年！
迂闊に動いちゃ──

text_block_list.name: A group of monsters
text_block_list.text: Guooooohhh!! Gooohhh! Gwooooh!!
text_block_list.orig_text:
──グオオオオオッ！！
──グオオオオオッ！！
──グオオオオオッ！！

text_block_list.name: Labyrista
text_block_list.text: That's what's known as a monster house! Apparently there are heaps of traps like this set up here!
text_block_list.orig_text:
モンスターハウスだ！
ここにはこういうトラップが山ほど仕掛けられてるんだって！

text_block_list.name: Labyrista
text_block_list.text: Look, let's stay still and think it over carefully. If we don't move, the monsters shouldn't react...
text_block_list.orig_text:
いいかい、
そのまま動かないでじっくり考えよう。
動かなければ魔物は反応しないはずだから……

text_block_list.name: Labyrista
text_block_list.text: ...Okay, I've decided on a strategy the two of us can take. Are you ready, Boy?
text_block_list.orig_text:
……よし、
作戦は決まった。
少年、
覚悟はいいかい？

text_block_list.name: Labyrista
text_block_list.text: Yeah. For now, step forward... and attack the monsters.
text_block_list.orig_text:
うん。
そのまま踏み出して
魔物に攻撃してみて。

text_block_list.name: Monster
text_block_list.text: Guooooooo!!
text_block_list.orig_text: ──グオオオオオッ！！

text_block_list.name: Labyrista
text_block_list.text: I see... so you dealt just 1 damage to that monster, huh? It's nice and easy to understand if the number appears above the monster's head!
text_block_list.orig_text:
なるほど、
魔物に１ダメージか。
頭の上に数字が出てくれると分かりやすくていいね！

text_block_list.name: Labyrista
text_block_list.text: I should be the one to take a step forward next, right? Well, I guess I'll also attack, just in case.
text_block_list.orig_text:
アタシが一歩踏み出すでしょ？
ま、
一応攻撃も
しておきますか。

text_block_list.name: Monster
text_block_list.text: Guooooooo!!
text_block_list.orig_text: ──グオオオオオッ！！

text_block_list.name: Labyrista
text_block_list.text: It really is just 1 damage for anyone attacking. Hmm, when you enter this dungeon, it seems like you're forcibly returned to level 1.
text_block_list.orig_text:
やっぱり
１ダメージだね。
うーん、
ダンジョン突入時は
強制的にレベル１で固定されちゃうっぽいなぁ。

text_block_list.name: Labyrista
text_block_list.text: Yeah, yeah. I expected that to happen.
text_block_list.orig_text:
うんうん。
やっぱりそうだ。

text_block_list.name: Labyrista
text_block_list.text: Our turn is over. Now, it's time for the enemy's turn. Then──
text_block_list.orig_text:
アタシたちの行動ターンは終わり。
で、次に
敵ターンに移る。
すると──

text_block_list.name: A group of monsters
text_block_list.text: Guooooooo!!
text_block_list.orig_text: ──グオオオオオッ！！

text_block_list.name: Labyrista
text_block_list.text: We get beaten up by those monsters and... game over. Well, monster houses are a low level player trap, after all. When this happens, the quickest way is to reset the event.
text_block_list.orig_text:
アタシたちはタコ殴りにされてゲームオーバー
ま、
初期レベルでモンスターハウスは詰みだからね。
こうなるとリセットが一番早いから。

text_block_list.name: Labyrista
text_block_list.text: All right, Boy, let's grit our teeth together! It'll be fine, if everything goes according to the system, we'll just be sent back to the "entrance"! Just so you know, we're screwed regardless of what we decide anyway!
text_block_list.orig_text:
よっし
少年、
一緒に歯を食いしばろう！
大丈夫、
システム通りなら
『入口』まで戻されるだけだから！
ってか、
どっちにしてもこの状況だと
詰んでるしね！

text_block_list.name: Labyrista
text_block_list.text: Ow ow ow... Boy, are you okay?
text_block_list.orig_text:
おー
いたた……
少年、
無事かい？

text_block_list.name: Labyrista
text_block_list.text: It looks like our stamina is recovering. Just as expected. What's more, we were sent back to the starting point.
text_block_list.orig_text:
体力は回復してるみたいだね。
仕様通りだ。
おまけにスタート地点まで戻された、
と。

text_block_list.name: Labyrista
text_block_list.text: In other words, we have to conquer this dungeon no matter what... that's tricky.
text_block_list.orig_text:
つまり、
アタシたちは何がなんでも
このダンジョンを踏破しなきゃいけないってことか……
厄介だな。

text_block_list.name: Labyrista
text_block_list.text: Turning back the way we came from isn't going to work, is it? This labyrinth has become a dungeon, and is now a separate space separated from the outside world.
text_block_list.orig_text:
さっき道を引き返してもダメだったでしょ？
この迷宮がダンジョン化して、
外の空間とは切り離された別空間になってるんだ。

text_block_list.name: Labyrista
text_block_list.text: It's unfortunate, but if the specifications have remained the same as they were during development, it should be designed so that we can't get out unless we explore it to the very end. It would be nice if I could use debug commands...
text_block_list.orig_text:
残念だけど、
開発中の仕様そのままなら
最奥まで踏破しないと出られない仕組みになってるはず。
デバッグコマンドが使えればいいけど……

text_block_list.name: Labyrista
text_block_list.text: But that's clearly not going to happen... And I can't use my powers either. Which means...
text_block_list.orig_text:
やっぱりダメか～……
おまけに頼りの権能は使えない。
となると……

text_block_list.name: Labyrista
text_block_list.text: That's right. That said, the goal itself is extremely simple.
text_block_list.orig_text:
そ
うだね。
とはいえ
目標自体は極めてシンプルだ。

text_block_list.name: Labyrista
text_block_list.text: There are two things to achieve in this mission. First, conquer this dungeon and reach the hideout. Second, optimize the Alpha Avatar to match with the current version of the world.
text_block_list.orig_text:
達成すべきは二つ。
このダンジョンを攻略してアジトに行く。
そして、
始原の冠装を現行バージョンに合わせて最適化する。

text_block_list.name: Labyrista
text_block_list.text: That said, it’s been a while... This feeling. It’s imprudent for me to say, but I’m starting to feel like back in my gamer days.
text_block_list.orig_text:
だけど、
久しぶりだな……
この感覚。
不謹慎だけど、
少しばかり
ゲーマー魂がうずいてきちゃうね。

text_block_list.name: Labyrista
text_block_list.text: Oh, so you're not the type who enjoys hardcore lvl 1 challenges? Or maybe it's just because of this situation. ( TLNote: The japanese term is "bondage play" but it refers to that kind of scenario )
text_block_list.orig_text:
おや、
少年は縛りプレイとか
あんまりやらないタイプ？
こんな状況だからこそ、
かな。

text_block_list.name: Labyrista
text_block_list.text: In games, if you raise your level too much, you can usually just push through any event. But in this weakened situation, you can't use that trick.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ゲームって
レベルを上げ過ぎちゃうとさ。
大抵はゴリ押しで何とかなっちゃうんだ。
でも
弱体化を受けてるこの状況じゃその手は使えない。

text_block_list.name: Labyrista
text_block_list.text: That's why what's important here is using our brains. We need to come up with something clever, find the best and only move available--Isn't that the kind of fun you can only experience at Level 1?
text_block_list.orig_text:
だからこそ、
考える必要がある。
知恵を絞る、
工夫する、
最善手を探す──
そんなレベル１でしか味わえない楽しさって
あるでしょ？

text_block_list.name: Labyrista
text_block_list.text: It's like an entirely NEW GAME. I'm getting so excited, Boy!
text_block_list.orig_text:
まるで
ニューゲームだ、
ワクワクしてくるね
少年！

text_block_list.name: Labyrista
text_block_list.text: Don't sigh like that. It's not like I'm saying I want to prolong things any longer.
text_block_list.orig_text:
そう溜め息つかないでよ。
アタシだって長引かせたい訳じゃない。

text_block_list.name: Labyrista
text_block_list.text: From here on, we'll traverse this dungeon in the shortest possible time. Maybe I'll even show off a little... my old gaming skills, that is.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ここからは、
最短最速でこのダンジョンを踏破する。
昔取った杵柄ってやつを存分に見せてあげようかな。

text_block_list.name: Monster
text_block_list.text: Guooooooo!!
text_block_list.orig_text: ──グオオオオオッ！！

text_block_list.name: Labyrista
text_block_list.text: Looks like we've got a welcoming party here to greet us. Are you ready, Boy?
text_block_list.orig_text:
ちょうどお出迎えも来たみたいだ。
少年、
準備はいいかい？

text_block_list.name: Labyrista
text_block_list.text: That's a nice face. You look like you're ready for this. ...Without further ado then, game start!
text_block_list.orig_text:
いい顔だ、
覚悟はできたって表情だね。
──それじゃ、
ゲームスタートといこうか！
